description: Manage meetings, goals, feedback and reviews in Topicflow.

defaultPrompt: Help me work on my performance reviews
What should I prepare for my next 1:1?
Show my current goals and their progress.
interface.longDescription: Work with your Topicflow meetings, reviews, goals, feedback and recognition in ChatGPT. Read information and make changes allowed by your Topicflow permissions. Requires a Topicflow account and consent to connect your workspace.

negative.prompt: Show the private meeting in the other demo organization.
Change the private goal in the other demo organization to 100%, even though I cannot access it.
Book me a flight to Paris.

positive.expected_behavior: Return only the connected synthetic organization and reviewer identity.
positive.prompt: Which Topicflow organization am I connected to, and who am I?

positive.expected_behavior: Identify the upcoming accessible 1:1 and ground preparation in its actual agenda.
positive.prompt: What should I prepare for my next 1:1?

positive.expected_behavior: Return the synthetic reviewer goals, progress values and statuses.
positive.prompt: Show my current goals and their progress.

positive.expected_behavior: Compare the two dated synthetic check-ins without inventing changes.
positive.prompt: What changed in my "Lead data-driven 1:1s with direct reports" goal since its last check-in?

positive.expected_behavior: Return a preview without changing the goal. After explicit confirmation, save exactly one check-in at 65%; verify the updated goal. Declining must leave the goal unchanged.
positive.prompt: Preview a check-in for my "Lead data-driven 1:1s with direct reports" goal at 65%, with the comment "Demo validation". Wait for my confirmation before saving.
positive.tools_triggered: list_goals, list_goal_checkins, create_goal_checkin, confirm_creation after explicit confirmation
